verified_static_design.approvals: Runner verifies approved B02 plan SHA and both G4 contract reviews against exact contract v2 SHA; verifies the v2 Authlib source review SHA and installed-library pins; pins immutable migrations 001 and 002.
verified_static_design.regression_inventory: Runner uses exact fixed G1 count 12, B01 Node count 48 with all zero skipped/todo/cancelled, and ledger-declared minimum/exact counts for G2, G3 and G4. Python coverage classes and aggregate case IDs are recorded. It also invokes the accepted source/profile baseline check through the unchanged G1 helper.
verified_static_design.source_capture: Before commands, the runner hashes itself, G1/G2/G3 runners, README, B02 plan, all Python/SQL/in/lock/json service and test files, and B02 evidence JSON; it compares the source inventory after execution. This captures the new runner and implementation/test sources. Requirements lock and installed authentication library files are checked separately.
verified_static_design.privacy_and_outputs: Each uniquely timestamped gate leaf is created mode 0700. Raw pytest XML and command logs remain in that leaf and private-* files are chmod 0600 before report publication. Published JUnit replaces only hostname; report exposes aggregate counts/case IDs, hashes, sanitized lifecycle and runtime observations, not raw output or request/profile data.
verified_static_design.runtime_observations: Runner requires actual G3 service aggregate with success/replay/provider-error/expiry cases, canary absence and service PID/log evidence; actual G4 aggregate with create/replay/conflict/authorization/fault/pagination/restart/race/bridge/CLI observations; and 2..16 service lifecycle records with exit/PID/log hashes and restrictive modes. It checks PostgreSQL lifecycle shutdown, fresh library hashes and source stability.
verified_static_design.timeouts: Configured test command timeouts are 300 seconds for Python and 180 seconds for Node, consistent with the G4 gate plan. No runner execution was performed for this review.

blockers.evidence: The Python runner compares G4 testcase count to expected_g4_pytest_cases, then records observed case IDs, but never compares those IDs with an independently pinned exact testcase-ID list from the TC ledger. A renamed or substituted case set of the same size can satisfy the current count gate while diverging from the reviewed case inventory.
blockers.required_resolution: Have the final TC ledger carry the exact expected G1/G2/G3/G4 case IDs (or at minimum G4 IDs plus the accepted prior inventories), pin that ledger in the gate, and compare sorted observed IDs exactly to the ledger before PASS. A count alone is insufficient for the frozen evidence claim.

conditional_recovery_note.evidence: On Python timeout, subprocess.run terminates the pytest process and the runner's failure cleanup targets the PostgreSQL fixture cluster. G4 tests also spawn actual Uvicorn child processes; if pytest is terminated before its finally blocks run, the runner itself does not independently confirm or clean a still-live Uvicorn PID.
conditional_recovery_note.required_resolution: Ensure the G4 service harness performs bounded cleanup on pytest interruption and retains process identity/liveness evidence, or have the runner consume a private service manifest and safely confirm stopped children. Any timed-out child must remain an explicit failure/uncertain cleanup outcome, never a pass.

execution_status: Read-only static runner review. No tests, service, database, or network were run. Do not treat this conditional review as gate approval or G4 acceptance.
